chunks.title: Turk Eximbank (Turk Eximbank) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Turk Eximbank is a National Development Bank headquartered in Türkiye. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Signed 4 international green financing agreements >$800M at COP31 Antalya (IBRD, KfW, AIIB). Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: >$800M secured at COP31 (€209.2M IBRD, €250M KfW, $200M + $100M AIIB) dedicated to Turkish exporters' green transition & shock resilience. Source verification: https://ua.news/en/dovkolo-svitu/turk-eximbank-zaluchiv-ponad-800-mln-na-cop31-u-turechchini-anadolu-agency.

chunks.title: Turk Eximbank Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Turk Eximbank provides the following climate financing instruments: Green Export Investment Loan, Export Working Capital Credit, Export Credit Insurance, MDB/DFI On-Lending Line. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 500,000 to USD 75,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, SME, Mid-Cap Enterprise.

chunks.title: Turk Eximbank Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Turk Eximbank: Industrial Decarbonization, Renewable Energy, Energy Efficiency, SME Green Transition, EU CBAM Export Compliance. Target geographic focus includes: Türkiye, Global Exports. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Turk Eximbank Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Turk Eximbank's application form: Verified Turkish exporter status & export commitment; Eligible green transition / CBAM decarbonization investment scope; IBRD / KfW / AIIB on-lending Environmental & Social screening; Bank letter of guarantee or eligible collateral. Explicit exclusion rules: Non-exporting domestic entities; Coal/fossil-fuel expansion. Official application portal: https://www.eximbank.gov.tr/en.

chunks.title: Turk Eximbank Form Template: Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form
chunks.text: Turk Eximbank uses the 'Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form' workflow governed by IFC Performance Standards / Harmonized DFI Climate Reporting (10by30 / IDFC). Typical review timeline is 4–12 weeks (Screening -> Due Diligence -> Credit Committee). Form sections required: 1. Sponsor Profile, 2. Transaction Structure, 3. Climate & Impact, 4. Financial Due Diligence, 5. Risk Assessment, 6. Executive Summary.
